observed.scaleText: Rating scale Use the same evidence standard for every category. Higher scores always indicate stronger evidence and fewer material gaps. 1 — Insufficient Evidence is absent or material concerns are unresolved. 2 — Weak Major evidence or execution gaps remain. 3 — Adequate Baseline expectations are met with manageable gaps. 4 — Strong The conclusion is well supported with only minor gaps. 5 — Exceptional Evidence is comprehensive and no material gaps remain.

assertions: The deployed Review editor presents a visible rating-scale block before the category rubric
Every value from 1 through 5 has a distinct label and behavioral evidence definition
The copy explicitly states that higher scores mean stronger evidence and fewer material gaps
